title: “In” (陰) and “Yo” (陽)
focus: “In” and “Yo” are the Japanese expression of the Chinese Yin and Yang principle. In Japanese, they are normally written in kanji as 陰陽 , read In-Yo . Although Yin and Yang are widely discussed in Chinese martial arts, the Japanese terms “In” and “Yo” are much less commonly mentioned in Aikido.
practicePrompt: Can a strong entry still contain softness?
